gallery.filename: Baltimore District conducts pre-storm assessments in Ocean City, Maryland (24772208599).jpg
gallery.title: File:Baltimore District conducts pre-storm assessments in Ocean City, Maryland (24772208599).jpg
gallery.artist: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers from USA
gallery.description: The Baltimore District Atlantic Coast of Maryland Shoreline Protection Project Pre-storm Conditional Assessment Team (ACMSPP-PCAT) collects four surveyed profiles in Ocean City, Maryland at different locations along the project, including at known hot-spots at 146th Street, 81st Street, and 32nd Street, on Oct. 1, 2015. Hot-spots are areas known to have higher rates of erosion than the adjacent shorelines. These surveyed cross-sections extend from the construction baseline to the waterline. These surveys were conducted in anticipation of Hurricane Joaquin in order to determine the condition of the flood risk management project prior to any potential storm effects. In case of storm damage, this process will help return the project back to pre-storm condition, using federal dollars, if storm damage assistance is requested.

gallery.filename: 1966 AMC Marlin in Apollo Yellow and black vinyl with 327 automatic 2021 AMO show 01of14.jpg
gallery.title: File:1966 AMC Marlin in Apollo Yellow and black vinyl with 327 automatic 2021 AMO show 01of14.jpg
gallery.artist: CZmarlin — Christopher Ziemnowicz, a photo credit would be appreciated if this image is used anywhere other than Wikipedia.
gallery.description:
1966 AMC Marlin. A sporty "personal-luxury" two-door hardtop (no "B" body pillar) with a distinctive fastback design built by American Motors Corporation (AMC). This car is finished in Apollo Yellow and has the optional black vinyl roof cover that extends from the windshield to over the trunk lid to the rear as well as in the side trim inserts around the side windows. The interior is in black with bucket seats and center arrests in front and back. It has AMC's 327 cu in (5.4 L) V8 engine with a center console shifted automatic transmission. This car also has AMC's optional "Turbocast" full wheel covers. 
Photographs were taken during the American Motors Owners (AMO) convention and car show that was held in Colorado Springs, Colorado.
